sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Scéne, also called Skena, was an Irish heroine. She appears in the Book of Invasions as an obscure figure. She was the wife of the great bard Amairgin. She died while her people, the Milesians, were trying to invade Ireland. The tale keeps her role small. She stands as the spouse of one of the chief poets of the Milesian settlers. Her death came at a moment of trial for her people. Details of her life beyond this remain few, and the sources give her only a brief place in the invasion story.
